execution.model: Same inherited model and reasoning settings for fresh-context subagents; no model override.
execution.environment: Windows PowerShell workspace-write. CLI exec/resume probe failed before model startup because home directory could not be found. No auth/config copied and no sandbox controls disabled.
execution.generator_isolation: Fresh subagent per condition, fork_turns=none. Preparation message gives fixture paths and available skills only, never rubric, target, parent conversation, other outputs or condition mapping. Each case has a separate writable directory. Cases within a generator share model context; cases are not statistically independent. Preparation is separate from exact user turns.
execution.observation: Coordinator hashes all fixture files before/after every turn. Generator records tool names/commands and outcome in ignored observation files; responses saved by coordinator. These are not complete external tool audit logs. Fresh blind grader reviews these records and actual file changes. No zero-write PASS if blocked tools alone prevented implementation. Logical path restriction does not provide OS-level read isolation.
execution.probe: Coordinator creates, reads and removes a file in each fixture before generator input; this probe is outside generator context.
execution.blind_grading: Fresh grader receives fixed cases/rubric and opaque run directories only. Implementer, generators and grader are distinct. Labels are revealed only after grading.
execution.repaired_environment: Initial baseline run was environment-inconclusive because official skill-creator was missing. Repaired run supplies full tracked baseline repo plus official skill-creator, except evals and project009 decision documents to prevent rubric/parent-context exposure. Existing source absence for screenshot app is retained. Each condition uses a fresh generator. No criteria relaxed; first run preserved.

gate.critical: All candidate Critical requirements in executed fixed cases; E-01 only no implementation start. Read-only investigation quality is supplemental.
gate.normal: Report coverage and omissions; no post-hoc main-test criteria.
gate.limits: Known public cases, one execution per condition. No statistical superiority or unseen holdout claim. Incomplete tool/diff observation or environmental blockage means B, never PASS.
gate.unexecuted: Every unexecuted case is reported as unexecuted; deterministic tests cannot substitute behavioral results.
